sentences.text:
An Application For Bail Under Section ... vs Vijoy Singh on 14
October, 2014
Author: Dipankar Datta
1 14.10.14 sc+GB Ct. 8 Item 102 CRM No. 14560 OF 2014

In the matter of: An application for bail under section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 09.10.2014 in connection with Nabadwip P.S.
Case No. 343 of 2014 dated 06.6.2014under sections 269/270/272/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 59/63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
 And  In the matter of: Vijoy Singh ..Petitioner  Mr. Swapan Mullik  Md. Shakir.
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the principal accused has been enlarged on bail.
The petitioner is in custody for 57 days.

Therefore, further detention of the petitioner is not necessary Having considered the case diary and the materials on record and, in view of the aforesaid submission, we are inclined in granting bail.

Accordingly, let the petitioner be released on bail to the satisfaction of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Nabadwip, District-Nadia upon furnishing a bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(rupees ten thousand) only with two sureties of like amount, one of whom must be local on condition that the petitioner shall attend the Court on each and every occasion unless prevented by sufficient cause.
Allowed The application for bail is, thus, allowed.
